directory.name: Vera's Pizza and Bar
directory.note: Late-night Ballard pizza-and-bar concept that opened in 2019 in the space of the longtime Vera's diner; New York-style slices with 48-hour fermented dough are the core of the menu, alongside a full bar.

candidateReview.name: Romio'S Pizza & Pasta
candidateReview.note: Same restaurant as the on-file 'Downtown Romio's Pizza & Pasta' at the identical 1011 Pike St address; the permit is filed under the plainer 'Romio'S Pizza & Pasta' name.

candidateReview.name: Seattle Pizza And Bar
candidateReview.note: Both permit branches (2801 Western Ave and 224 Fairview Ave N) belong to the single on-file 'Seattle Pizza & Bar' business, which operates both locations.

candidateReview.name: Sopranos Pizza - Lake City
candidateReview.note: Same restaurant as the on-file 'Soprano's Pizza & Pasta - Lake City' at the identical 11754 15th Ave NE address.

candidateReview.name: Tutta Bella Neapolitan Pizzeria

candidateReview.name: Tutta Bella Neapolitan Pizzeria (Kc489)
candidateReview.note: A second permit registration at the same 4918 Rainier Ave S address already covered by the on-file 'Tutta Bella' chain; not a separate business.
